newsitem.title: USA: Henry Schein to buy Dentrix.
newsitem.headline: Henry Schein to buy Dentrix.

text.p: Henry Schein Inc said Friday it acquired Dentrix Dental Systems Inc, a provider of clinically-based dental practice management systems in the Microsoft Windows environment, with 1996 sales of $10.3 million.
The company said the acquisition will be treated as a pooling of interests and is expected to be accretive to 1997 earnings.
The company said it anticipates recording a non-recurring charge related to the transaction in 1997, but did not predict the amount of the charge.
Dentrix had over 45 percent annual sales growth in each of the last two years and has installed over 3,500 dental practice management systems, Henry Schein said.
